# 解读Google的好SEO就是好GEO及其推广套餐

作者：@alexgroberman  
日期：2026-10-30（北京时间）  
来源：[X原帖](https://x.com/alexgroberman/status/2116196567275438376)  
分类：方法

## 中文全文

Google 公布了在 AI 搜索中出现的最佳方法。

是的，他们终于明确谈到了企业和品牌应该如何获得流量。

这些内容直接来自 Google 的 Brendon Kraham。

Google 最近发表了一篇新文章，名为《好的 SEO 就是好的 GEO》。

我们来逐项看看。

顺便说一句，你可以在这里查看自己的企业是否出现在 Google AI、ChatGPT、Claude、Perplexity 和 Grok 中。免费：

[seo-stuff.com/free-audit](https://t.co/Evw8cXXicl)

核心观点很简单。

Google 表示，它的生成式 AI 功能基于与传统搜索相同的核心排名与质量系统。

AI Mode 和 AI Overviews 从 Google 现有搜索索引中检索最新信息。

这很重要，因为过去一年里，很多人的表现像是 AI 搜索需要一套完全独立的操作手册。

GEO、AEO、LLM SEO、AI SEO——随便大家这周想叫它什么。

Google 基本上是在说：基础仍然是 SEO。

[SEO Stuff](https://t.co/wKpf0EILTx) 每天帮助企业处理这些问题。

当然，事情确实发生了变化。

AI Overviews 正在改变点击行为，AI Mode 正在改变人们的搜索方式，而查询扩展（query fan-out）意味着一个客户问题可能在后台变成多次搜索，但基本要求仍然很熟悉。

Google 必须能够抓取你的内容、理解它在讲什么、信任它，并将它与搜索者真正想要的东西匹配起来。

Google 的文章也反驳了很多正在被销售的捷径。

你不需要为机器人写生硬的内容，不需要到处塞人为制造的摘要片段，不需要为 Google 搜索准备特殊的 AI 文本文件，也不需要向整个网络到处撒低质量提及。

最后一点尤其重要。

Google 表示，其生成式 AI 功能可以利用网络各处的产品和服务信息，包括博客、视频和论坛讨论。

但随便某个页面上的一次虚假提及，不等于可信报道、客户证据、专家评论、有用的第三方背景资料，或者已经在这个主题上拥有权威性的页面。

很多糟糕的 GEO 建议就错在这里。

人们听说“AI 会看整个网络”，便以为更多提及必然意味着更高可见度。

Google 的建议直接得多：发布新鲜且真正有用的内容，贡献原创信息，展示真实专业能力，保持良好的网站体验，并在与你相关的平台上维护准确的企业信息。

对电商而言，这可能包括商品数据源。

对本地企业而言，是 Google Business Profile。

Search Console 和 Merchant Center 则能帮助你了解，这些工作是否转化为可见度。

都是很普通、也很枯燥的 SEO 工作。

Google 还专门谈到了查询扩展。普通搜索可能只有一个查询，而复杂的 AI Mode 问题会触发围绕相关子主题的多次搜索。

如果有人问，哪款薪资软件最适合一家在多个州都有雇员和承包商的建筑公司，Google 可能需要查找建筑业工资核算、承包商付款、跨州合规、定价、集成、替代方案和支持服务等信息。

一个泛泛的“薪资软件”页面，大概无法覆盖整个决策过程。

一家在这些不同问题上都有实用页面的公司，会在 Google 研究答案时获得更多被发现的机会。

所以，不应把“好的 SEO 就是好的 GEO”理解为“继续做你2019年就在做的那套肤浅 SEO”。

基础仍然重要，但围绕客户决策提供的实用信息，其数量与具体程度变得更加重要。

Google has revealed the best way to show up in AI Search.

Yes, they finally explicitly addressed how businesses and brands should be getting traffic.

This comes straight from Google’s Brendon Kraham.

Google recently published a new piece called “Good SEO is good GEO.”

Let’s go through it.

The main point is pretty simple.

Google says its generative AI features are rooted in the same core ranking and quality systems as traditional Search.

AI Mode and AI Overviews retrieve current information from Google’s existing search index.

That matters because a lot of people have spent the last year acting like AI search requires some completely separate playbook.

GEO, AEO, LLM SEO, AI SEO, whatever people want to call it this week.

Google is basically saying the foundation is still SEO.

SEO Stuff (
http://
seo-stuff.com) helps businesses navigate this daily. 

Obviously, stuff *has* changed.

AI Overviews are changing click behavior, AI Mode is changing how people search and query fan-out means one customer question can become several searches behind the scenes, but the basic requirement is still familiar.

Google needs to be able to crawl your content, understand what it is about, trust it and match it to what the searcher actually wants.

Google’s post also pushes back on a lot of the shortcuts people have been selling.

You do not need awkward content written for bots, artificial snippets everywhere, special AI text files for Google Search or random low-quality mentions sprayed across the web.

That last one is important.

Google says its generative AI features can use information about products and services from across the web, including blogs, videos and forum discussions.

But a fake mention on some random page is not the same as credible coverage, customer proof, expert commentary, useful third-party context or a page that already has authority around the topic.

That is where a lot of bad GEO advice goes wrong.

People hear “AI looks across the web” and assume more mentions automatically means more visibility.

Google’s guidance is much more straightforward: publish fresh and genuinely useful content, contribute something original, demonstrate real expertise, maintain a good website experience and keep your business information accurate across the platforms relevant to you.

For e-commerce, that can include product feeds.

For local businesses, Google Business Profile.

And Search Console and Merchant Center can help you understand whether that work is translating into visibility.

Very normal SEO things and very boring SEO things.

Google also specifically talks about query fan-out. A normal search may involve one query, whereas a complicated AI Mode question can trigger several searches across related subtopics.

If somebody asks for the best payroll software for a construction company with employees and contractors across multiple states, Google may need information about construction payroll, contractor payments, multi-state compliance, pricing, integrations, alternatives and support.

One generic “payroll software” page probably will not cover the whole decision.

A company with useful pages across those different questions has more opportunities to be discovered while Google researches the answer.

That is why “good SEO is good GEO” should not be interpreted as “keep doing the same shallow SEO you were doing in 2019.”

The fundamentals still matter, but the amount and specificity of useful information surrounding the customer’s decision matters more.
